Fewer than 75% of subperiods are profitable
Historical results do not guarantee live profitability

assumptions: 15% volatility target with a 100% gross-exposure cap

warnings: Sample is too small for promotion

Block-bootstrap probability of a positive mean is below 95%

Historical results do not guarantee live profitability
